## What's Changed * allow playlists to prioritize and control looping [#312](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/312) * support faster playback by decoding faster than refresh [#452](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/452) * handle stretching on ultrawide screens [#472](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/472) * preserve quota until it's about to expire [#275](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/275) * remove legacy Metal text rendering, keep only CATextLayer path [#500](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/500) * improve default focus in onboarding wizard [#495](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/495) * include git hash and build date in log output [#502](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/502) * log dream names in addition to UUIDs * move download percentage indicator [#471](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/471)
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/compare/0.14.4...0.14.5
